observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same Singer sewing machine from slightly different angles.
The machine is beige and brown with a large dial on the right side and a needle area in the center.
The brand 'SINGER' is visible on the top right of the machine in both photos.
The model number '7104' is visible next to the brand name in both photos.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with other sewing machines and tools in the background.
There is a red ruler or measuring tape visible in the lower left corner of both photos.
The machine has a foot pedal and a handwheel on the left side, visible in photo 0.
The surface of the machine shows some wear and minor scuffs, especially on the beige plastic parts.
No power cord or plug is visible in either photo.
No signs of damage to the needle or presser foot are visible, but the internal mechanism is not shown.
